method.p1: Exact status agreement; exact positive sample-time-set agreement at 10-second sampling. A three-agent status majority is recorded as agent consensus only. For sample points, positive/negative votes are compared to the per-point majority; no majority is called gold truth.
method.p2_p3: Presence sets use fixed aliases with person subclasses kept distinct (man, woman, generic person), plus table/round-table, plant/tree, laptop, and hands. For geometry only, man/woman/person are grouped as person. Within each sample and geometry class, force a maximum-total-IoU one-to-one pairing of min(class counts), including zero-IoU pairs; report IoU >= 0.5, visibility exact match, and confidence exact match.
method.p2_identity: Original A/B shared-link comparison is retained. Third label rows have stable per-source entity IDs but no explicit identity_link records, so no three-way cross-source identity-link agreement is claimed.
method.p4: Lowercase words and remove punctuation, then LCS-align normalized words pairwise. Timing agrees when both boundaries are within 0.1 seconds; overlap and condition compare exactly. Speaker IDs are not compared literally; compare same/different relations for adjacent aligned words.

p4.boundary_disagreement: LC4932 final partial word at 150 seconds

blind_agent_label_agreement.verdict_effect: Third-agent agreement is now scored, but these remain agent labels, not human/gold truth. P1 status disputes Q01/LC4930 and Q03/LC4930 resolve to present by B+C majority; P1 sample-time sets remain non-unanimous. P2/P3 class-presence sets remain non-exact and box overlap is limited. P4 words/timing agree strongly, while condition and speaker-relation fields disagree. Do not call any agent majority gold truth or infer detector/speech model accuracy from label agreement alone.
blind_agent_label_agreement.provenance_note: A report predates its P1-P4 JSON outputs and says none were emitted; the actual A JSON artifacts were scored. C report says 74 baseline records; labels-baseline.jsonl contains 74 records. All three sources are independent agent labels from different model families; no human labels were collected.
